description:
From the fz-kdt.119 cold review (2026-09-01), PRE-EXISTING at
b32d645ac (probes rev119/refnest.fz, refnest2.fz): a closure nested
in a tuple ({:tag, fn}) threaded through one forwarding hop fails
native lowering ('native executable lowering failed for index 13',
interp correct); the pattern-destructured variant fails ALL THREE
doors ('backend value 0 is unbound' / lowering failed). fz-kdt.127's
compiles-on-no-path shape at depth 1. Consequence: fz-kdt.119(2)'s
REFNEST acceptance probe is UNCONSTRUCTIBLE until this is fixed --
119's nested-callable separation can only be gated by unit tests at
the dispatch layer until then. Related: fz-kdt.127 (owns the same
shape at depth 0), fz-kdt.117 (closure-carrier parity family).
title: P1: a closure nested in a tuple through a forwarding hop compiles on no path
